caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, off-white or light beige background. The object is a cross with a circular ring intersecting its arms. The cross and ring are rendered in a brown color, resembling rusted iron or oxidized metal. Each of the four ends of the cross has a small, rounded trefoil or clover-like terminal. The vertical section below the center extends downward, forming a longer shaft, and is depicted with a textured, uneven surface suggesting it is made of metal. Near the lower right of the cross, there is handwritten text that appears to be a signature and possibly a date. The composition is minimal, with the cross occupying the central part of the image and ample empty space surrounding it.
title: Wrought Iron Cross, Campanario
